charts.name: Status of Tasks Over Time
charts.description: The 5 task-status counts above, summed across connectors, over time.
charts.programText:
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_running_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='running')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_failed_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='failed')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_paused_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='paused')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_unassigned_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='unassigned')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_destroyed_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='destroyed')

charts.name: CPU Usage
charts.description: process_cpu_seconds_total, by worker instance, 2-minute timeshift delta.
charts.programText:
raw = data('process_cpu_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum(by=['service.instance.id'])
((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='CPU Usage')

charts.name: JVM Memory Used
charts.description: jvm_memory_bytes_used vs jvm_memory_bytes_max{area=heap}, by worker instance.
charts.programText:
data('jvm_memory_bytes_used', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='Used')
data('jvm_memory_bytes_max', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect') and filter('area', 'heap')).sum(by=['service.instance.id']).publish(label='Max Heap')
